The '''Sphere of Military Strategy''', also known as the '''Ministry of Military Strategy '''and the '''Pyramid of Military Strategy''', was one of twelve [[Spheres of Influence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Headed by a [[Dark Council]]or, the Sphere was responsible for the strategies and plans that allowed the [[Sphere of Military Offense|Spheres of Military Offense]] and [[Sphere of Defense of the Empire|Defense of the Empire]] to lead the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] to victory.

==History==
[[Darth Azamin]] was the head of the Sphere during the [[Great Galactic War]], and he was succeeded by [[Darth Decimus]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

After the Empire's defeat at the hand of the [[Eternal Empire]], the sphere was combined with the Spheres of Military Offense and Defense of the Empire into the [[Sphere of Military Command]] by Empress [[Darth Acina]].<ref name="SOTG" />
